capabilities: Generate a Bible reading plan note
Split long chapters into verse ranges
Mark books or chapters already read
Tick days and single chapters as read
Show progress and today's reading in the status bar
extras: Unofficial and not affiliated with jw.org; the plugin only creates links and does not include Bible text. Plan language and the language JW Library opens are separate settings.
problem: Building a balanced daily Bible reading schedule by hand, and keeping track of which chapters have been read, takes manual work.

relations.evidence: links that open the chapter in JW Library

summary: Creates a Bible reading plan note with daily checklists of chapter links that open in JW Library, plus progress tracking.
